# rustinion_permission_role_mapping (Resource)

Maps an identity-provider group onto a rustinion_permission_role, so directory membership decides who holds the role. SCIM mappings apply when the IdP pushes a group change; OIDC and SAML mappings apply at each sign-in, from the ID token's groups claim or the assertion's group attribute respectively. Assignments made by hand are never touched by a sync.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `external_group` (String) The IdP's own group name — a SCIM Group `displayName`, one entry of an OIDC `groups` claim, or one value of a SAML assertion's group attribute. Matched case-insensitively.
- `role_id` (String) The role membership of that group confers (`rustinion_permission_role.example.id`).
- `source` (String) One of "scim", "oidc" or "saml". Part of the mapping's identity, so changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Scope the resulting assignment to one group. Omit for tenant-wide.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned mapping ID.
